text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The classic-year summer camp is an
important
event which tests the limit of
how much an
Umamusume can improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to depart for camp, and

everyone is settling in for the trip.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita! Have you already decided
who to sit
with yet? If not, come and join
me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I couldn't possibly sit next to
you, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How about sitting next to me, then? I'll
share my
carrots with you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! I appreciate the offer,
Spe, but... I
can't accept.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why not? Did we do something to upset
you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it at all! You've done
nothing
wrong. I'm just being weird.
Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's just... it's hard to hang out with them
because I
feel inferior to them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Kitasan Black is still bothered
by the
innate brilliance in Tokai Teio
and Special Week
that we talked about
before.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kita! Didja have lunch yet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If not, come eat with us! I got some corn
us cool
kids can chow down on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Golshi, Vodka! Sure, I'll join you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, she doesn't seem
bothered by
Gold Ship or Vodka, an
upperclassman who's
always trying to be
cool.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Huh, I guess you're right. I don't
feel any
particular need to keep a
distance from them...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why, though. Both of them are
incredible
racers, after all...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course we're incredible! Our hearts
are jacked
up more than jackets
themselves!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'd say we're incredible. I
feel like
we're more like lawless rebels
without a cause...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rebels... Vodka said it as an offhand
comment,
but I feel like the answer to
Kitasan Black's
question lies in that
sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean by that? What's
because of
their personalities?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how each Umamusume has a
certain air
about them that is reflected
in their personalities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some have more standard personalities,
while
others deviate from the norm—the
outliers.
Kitasan Black probably finds it
easier to approach
the latter. And if so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Okay, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod at her approvingly. I'm sure it'll
help if
Kitasan Black receives guidance
from a variety of
different
upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you can put up with us, we'll
hang out with
you as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you need someone to look up to,
count me in!
I'll take good care of you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Vodka! I really appreciate
that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Don't sweat it! I'll show you all the
wildest
ways to have fun this summer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We'll teach ya right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hang on, "we"? Golshi, your idea of fun goes waaay beyond wild...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm really hoping that Kitasan Black will
be able
to shake off her inferiority
complex this summer
with the help of
other Umamusume.
